1. Identify blue head with white arrow: locate the blue segment with white arrow (direction indicator).  
2. Note position: record grid coordinates (row, column) of blue head (starting at 1 for top/left).  
3. Trace body: follow green segments connected consecutively from head toward tail (fading lighter); note each segment's (row, column).  
4. Locate red food: find red circle; record its (row, column).  
5. Determine tail: identify pointed end of green body (farthest from head); confirm it is the tail segment.  
6. Confirm connections: ensure all
